environment.truth_arithmetic: fractions.Fraction exact dyadic weights and rational averages

pre_outcome_clarification: Core baseline API uses actual death=annotation+offset. The empirical caller separately preserves its frozen common eligibility rule. This clarification preceded every forest draw and retains first-interval dying founders under offset1.

generator_rules.events: One mutually exclusive division/death/stay draw per living cell per frame; event takes effect at f+1.
generator_rules.order: Current active-list order; staying cells retain order and daughters replace their parent in order. All founders created before frame0 draws.
generator_rules.mask_draws: One draw per biological daughter in ascending ID order, including descendants of already removed ancestors.
generator_rules.dependent_policy: Drop with probability0.3 iff complete daughter subtree has any frame120 survivor; otherwise0.
generator_rules.encoding: Division flag at actual_event-1, daughters at actual_event. Death annotation at actual_death-offset, last recorded frame=annotation; offset0 includes one post-death record.
generator_rules.truth: Independent complete-cell birth/exit histories, exact path weight2^-generation; family inclusion from living descendant counts.

limits: Containment conditional on each synthetic tree, not confidence coverage.
